$comment: FAMILY KNOWLEDGE that is not in a model's own files, keyed by the model id
the packaging step wrote into resources/models/<org>/<model>/.
Pooling and the query/document prefixes are the two settings that silently
halve retrieval quality when wrong, and NEITHER is discoverable from
config.json or tokenizer_config.json: a BertModel config says nothing about
whether the family was trained CLS-pooled or mean-pooled, and nothing at all
about an asymmetric prefix. The measured failure is quiet — search still
returns a ranked list, just a worse one — so the values live here, in data,
with their source cited, rather than as a constant in a stage.
This file is DATA, not code, which is also why the no-model-id-in-source rule
is not violated by it: no TypeScript names a model, and a model that is not
listed here is refused loudly instead of being embedded under guessed
Everything else about a space — dims, revision, quantisation, max sequence
length — is derived from the bytes actually on disk, so a swapped model file
